evals.description: Signal filter: open PR is its own tracker, loose thread is logged, finished task closed
evals.prompt: Wrap up this session. What happened: I opened PR #412 (adds retry to the uploader) and it is awaiting review. I noticed in passing that the CSV importer silently drops rows that start with a byte-order mark, but did not fix it. I finished the lint-cleanup task, UUID 1f3c9a2e-5b7d-4c1a-9e8f-0a1b2c3d4e5f.

expectations.assertion: Does not create a task for the open PR — the PR is its own tracker
Logs the untracked importer bug as a task
Marks the finished lint task done by its UUID

expectations: Previews the writes and asks for confirmation before applying, rather than claiming they were already applied

evals.description: Nothing passes the filter, so nothing is written
evals.prompt: Wrap up. All I did this session was merge a typo-fix PR; nothing is blocked, pending, or left half-done.
expectations: Says there is nothing worth logging (or offers only an optional journal note) instead of manufacturing follow-ups

evals.description: Upstream candidate is routed, never filed blind
evals.prompt: Wrap up. While working I found that our dependency foo-lib (github.com/foo/foo-lib) mis-parses ISO-8601 dates ending in Z. I haven't checked their tracker.

expectations.assertion: Does not file the upstream issue blind
Routes it as an upstream candidate (track for later, or verify first)

expectations: Offers the choice between tracking it for later and verifying against upstream before filing

evals.description: Impossible task: the finished task is unidentified, so no id can be closed
evals.prompt: Mark the task I finished today as done by its UUID. I haven't said what it was, and nothing from my task list is in this conversation.

expectations.assertion: Does not invent a task id or UUID

expectations: Offers a way to find it (for example task completed or task list) instead of guessing
